children: Overview
UK multi-energy distributor's H1 revenue rose 20.2% yr/yr to £7.3 bln
Adjusted operating profit for H1 up 1.1% to £175.2 mln
Adjusted EPS rose 25.6%, mainly due to lower share count after buybacks
Outlook
DCC Energy expects ongoing strategic progress, growth and continued development activity in the yr ahead
Company expects transition to private ownership in Q1 2027, pending completion of acquisition
Energy Services faces challenging near-term market conditions; long-term demand drivers remain attractive
Result Drivers
ENERGY PRODUCTS AND MOBILITY - Co said strong trading and margin development in Energy Products and Mobility offset lower volumes, helping drive profit growth
LOWER VOLUMES - Energy Products and Mobility both saw lower volumes due to factors including warmer weather, pull-forward of demand, and changes to fuel duty regimes
CHALLENGING ENERGY SERVICES - Energy Services segment continued to face difficult market conditions, with weak demand and margin pressure in most markets
